newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: NWE oil products - gas oil down, fuel oil steady.
newsitem.headline: NWE oil products - gas oil down, fuel oil steady.

text.p: NWE oil products opened mixed on Friday, gas oil down with futures and fuel oil steady, dealers said.
Trade remained slight as a number of players extended Thursday's public holiday in much of Europe into the weekend.
Heating oil barges were down over $1 a tonne as IPE May gas oil futures fell. Sellers were reluctant to offer into a vacuum, but premiums were unchanged at around IPE +$1 fob Rotterdam.
High sulphur fuel oil barges were offered at unchanged levels -- $82 fob Rotterdam.
